/scripts.value:
on ReOrderFIB
	local tNewCorrectAnswer
	repeat with xBlank = 1 to numberOfBlanks
		if temp_reorderBlankDestination < temp_reorderBlankNumber then
			// UP
			if xBlank = temp_reOrderBlankDestination then
				put line temp_reOrderBlankNumber of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line temp_reOrderBlankDestination of tNewCorrectAnswer
			else if xBlank = temp_reOrderBlankNumber then
				put line temp_reOrderBlankDestination of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line temp_reOrderBlankNumber of tNewCorrectAnswer
			else
				put line xBlank of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line xBlank of tNewCorrectAnswer
			end if
		else if temp_reOrderBlankDestination > temp_reOrderBlankNumber then
			// DOWN
			if xBlank = temp_reOrderBlankDestination then
				put line xBlank of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line temp_reOrderBlankNumber of tNewCorrectAnswer
			else if xBlank = temp_reOrderBlankNumber then
				put line xBlank of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line temp_reOrderBlankDestination of tNewCorrectAnswer
			else
				put line xBlank of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer into line xBlank of tNewCorrectAnswer
			end if
		end if
	end repeat
	
	put tNewCorrectAnswer into currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer 
end ReorderFIB
